The screen shows 5 gold at the top right, and the menu lists "Rest (20 gold)" in the same style as the enabled "Talk" option. Nothing marks it as disabled or says the party can't afford it, so resting is offered as if it would work.

In src/screens/camp.tsx the new `choose` calls `rest()`. When `result.ok` is false it calls `setSaid` with "Resting costs ${REST_COST} gold, and you don’t have enough." Both Enter and click go through `choose(i)`, and per the Note `rest` itself refuses without enough gold.

Both the Enter key handler and the click handler now call `choose`, which sets this message in the same `said` text the screen already showed for 'Look around' and 'Talk'.

With 5 gold shown at the top right, the menu still lists "Rest (20 gold)" in the same style as "Talk". It is not greyed out, marked unavailable or labelled as needing more gold, so it is offered as if it would work.
